definitions.explanation: A highly skilled craftsperson, especially one who works with their hands in traditional crafts such as woodworking, metalwork, or stonework. A somewhat literary or formal term.

examples.japanese: ⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{工匠|こうしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}められた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧{工匠|こうしょう}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{建|た}てられた→建てる：01189_tateru⟧。
examples.english: This temple was built by a renowned master craftsman.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中世|ちゅうせい}→中世：05524_chuusei⟧⟦ヨーロッパ→ヨーロッパ：00427_yooroppa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{工匠|こうしょう}たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大聖堂|だいせいどう}→大聖堂：20731_daiseidou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一生|いっしょう}→一生：01728_isshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捧|ささ}げた→捧げる：02055_sasageru⟧。
examples.english: Medieval European artisans devoted their lives to the construction of cathedrals.

notes:
Composed of {工|こう} (craft, construction) and {匠|しょう} (artisan, master). A more literary and formal word than the everyday ⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧. Often used in historical or elevated contexts to describe builders, sculptors, and other skilled manual workers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{工匠|こうしょう}: skilled artisan
- {名工匠|めいこうしょう}: famous master craftsman
- {工匠|こうしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧: artisan's skill

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧: craftsman, artisan — the everyday term; broader and more common
- {匠|たくみ}: master, artisan — used alone as a more poetic or branding-oriented term
- {名匠|めいしょう}: master craftsman — emphasizes fame and exceptional skill
- ⟦{大工|だいく}→大工：04051_daiku⟧: carpenter — specifically a woodworking tradesperson
